critical_code_review_comments: MINOR (informational only, do NOT fix per sprint constraints): maskHead is called with `${appId}:${accessToken}` combined. Because Fyers appIds are typically >= 12 chars (e.g. 'XCXXXXXXXX-100'), the printed first-12 window is entirely appId and the token is fully masked. If a shorter/misconfigured appId (< ~12 chars) is ever used, up to (12 - len(appId) - 1) leading chars of the access token could appear in logs. Consider masking appId and token independently in a follow-up sprint. Harness already verifies non-leakage for the current typical appId length.

MINOR (informational): HTTP status/headers are intentionally logged as '(not exposed by fyers-api-v3 SDK)' — this is expected given the SDK abstracts axios. For the support case, main agent may want to note that raw axios interception via the SDK's internal `request` instance is possible but was explicitly excluded from this LOG-ONLY sprint.

POSITIVE: Diagnostics correctly annotated as TEMPORARY with clear removal marker; logger.warn/error used so blocks are visible without a global log-level change; error path unambiguously rethrows via `throw err`.
